packet.prompt: Independent source-only review of this in-progress owner-qualified alias integration. The actual product is arbitrary story/script/original WAV to faithful animated actors, not a machine-specific demo. New contract: prop IDs are local to each actual story person; every actor/prop pair has exactly one explicit model binding, legacy omission only actual primary; no invisible primary; canonical entity relation/effect centers consume the union of actual owners compiled piecewise-linear prop frames by partId, not bare propId; shared ownership is separate canonical bake. Original source/world/action/hand/cue/art/stage/clock and SVG namespace guards remain mandatory. Parent handles cinematic relation/renderer/ownership layer integration and test declarations separately; they are not in your review scope. Find only concrete correctness defects in supplied text, including where implicit global alias assumptions persist or the new checks reject valid source. Do not propose broad refactors or isolated production guard removal. No execution, tools, callbacks, fixtures, samplers, schema instances, renderer, browser, server, test/API/media/TTS/ASR/audio/video. Preserve needs-source-prop-binding, productionReady=false, all approvals false and availableBanks empty. Do not manufacture findings; flag missing context as uncertainty. Return JSON {status:"reviewed",changedPaths:[],commandsRun:[],findings:[{severity:"high"|"medium",file,location,evidence,scenario,requiredCorrection}],remainingRisks:[]}. This frozen review is not runtime or whole-diff acceptance.

findings.evidence: The legacy primary branch requires !c.actorScene && binding.ownerId===undefined. With no actorScene and an explicit ownerId equal to c.leadCharacterId, that branch is skipped; the supporting lookup then produces [], and the binding is rejected. Meanwhile, assertPropAliasCoverage() declares the no-actorScene primary's aliases using c.leadCharacterId.
findings.scenario: An otherwise-valid legacy primary/presenter binding is accepted with ownerId omitted but rejected when it explicitly names that same actual primary. Explicitly qualifying an already-valid primary should not turn its binding into an unknown supporting-owner lookup.
findings.requiredCorrection: In the no-actorScene legacy path, permit an explicit ownerId naming the same verified actual primary used by omission, while rejecting other owner IDs. Preserve visible-owner requirements, explicit original-source ownership, SVG namespace checks and all pending-production gates.
